The chapters in this volume are collected directly from the magazine publication of Pokémon Adventures and are collected independently of [[Shogakukan]]'s collected releases of the magazine version. ==Blurb== Violet and Arven attempt to improve their battle skills through their encounters with wild Pokémon and Team Star in preparation to face the Titan Pokémon. Meanwhile, Scarlet continues her journey in search of the Treasures of Ruin.
